product.name: Relay
product.summary: Relay turns scattered customer feedback into grouped product insights and scoped build tasks.
product.audience: Founder-led software teams that need a clear path from customer notes to the next build.
product.promise: Collect the signal, connect repeated requests, and hand the team a build-ready task.

direction: A crisp editorial product film on warm white: oversized ink typography, electric-blue actions, lavender depth planes, and a single continuous feedback-to-build workflow. Perspective and soft light give the UI physical presence while every frame remains legible at feed scale.

brand.basis: Designed fictional fixture; no real product brand claimed

scenes.copy: Customer feedback is everywhere. The signal is not.
scenes.motion: Loose feedback cards drift in from different edges, overlap, and settle around the headline while the cursor beam searches without finding a center.

scenes.copy: Meet Relay. One inbox for what customers need next.
scenes.motion: The scattered cards align into Relay's inbox as the product shell rises from the lavender stage; the newest note receives a quiet blue focus state.

scenes.copy: Relay groups the repeated request: Team permissions.
scenes.motion: Four feedback rows peel from the inbox, connect along blue paths, and stack into one insight card; the shared phrase highlights in sequence.

scenes.copy: Turn the insight into a build-ready task.
scenes.motion: The insight card docks beside a task composer; problem, scope, and acceptance checks reveal top to bottom before the Create task button confirms.

scenes.copy: Ship what customers asked for. Start with Relay.
scenes.motion: The completed workflow condenses into three connected stages, the build-ready task slides into place, and the final call to action gains a restrained blue glow.
